examples: 我明天工作。
Wǒ míngtiān gōngzuò.
I work tomorrow.
明天我们一起去公园玩，好吗？
Míngtiān wǒmen yìqǐ qù gōngyuán wán, hǎo ma?
Shall we go to the park together tomorrow?
我昨天在家。
Wǒ zuótiān zài jiā.
I was at home yesterday.
昨天我和姐姐在家看了电影。
Zuótiān wǒ hé jiějie zài jiā kàn le diànyǐng.
Yesterday my older sister and I watched a movie at home.
我在学校学习。
Wǒ zài xuéxiào xuéxí.
I study at school.
我妹妹每天八点去学校上课。
Wǒ mèimei měi tiān bā diǎn qù xuéxiào shàngkè.
My younger sister goes to school at eight every day.
我妈妈在医院工作。
Wǒ māma zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.
My mom works at the hospital.
妈妈在医院工作，她是一名医生。
Māma zài yīyuàn gōngzuò, tā shì yì míng yīshēng.
My mother works at a hospital; she's a doctor.
我在家。
Wǒ zài jiā.
I am at home.
我们家有四口人，都喜欢喝茶。
Wǒmen jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén, dōu xǐhuan hē chá.
There are four people in our family; we all like tea.
我今天不工作。
Wǒ jīntiān bù gōngzuò.
I am not working today.
我爸爸每天早上八点开始工作。
Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang bā diǎn kāishǐ gōngzuò.
My dad starts work at eight every morning.
你好！
Nǐ hǎo!
Hello!
见到朋友时，我会说“你好，很高兴见到你！”
Jiàn dào péngyou shí, wǒ huì shuō “Nǐ hǎo, hěn gāoxìng jiàn dào nǐ!”
When I see a friend, I say, “Hello, nice to see you!”
谢谢你。
Xièxie nǐ.
Thank you.
谢谢你今天帮我学习中文。
Xièxie nǐ jīntiān bāng wǒ xuéxí Zhōngwén.
Thank you for helping me study Chinese today.
再见，明天见！
Zàijiàn, míngtiān jiàn!
Goodbye, see you tomorrow!
今天很高兴认识你，明天再见！
Jīntiān hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ, míngtiān zàijiàn!
It was nice to meet you today; see you tomorrow!
请喝茶。
Qǐng hē chá.
Please have some tea.
请给我一杯水，谢谢！
Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ, xièxie!
Please give me a glass of water, thank you!
对不起，我不知道。
Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù zhīdào.
Sorry, I don't know.
对不起，我今天不能和你一起去。
Duìbuqǐ, wǒ jīntiān bù néng hé nǐ yìqǐ qù.
I'm sorry, I can't go with you today.
“对不起。”“没关系。”
“Duìbuqǐ.” “Méi guānxi.”
“Sorry.” “It's okay.”
“对不起，我来晚了。”“没关系，快坐吧。”
“Duìbuqǐ, wǒ lái wǎn le.” “Méi guānxi, kuài zuò ba.”
“Sorry I'm late.” “It's okay; have a seat.”
我今天不工作。
Wǒ jīntiān bù gōngzuò.
I am not working today.
我不喜欢喝咖啡，但是喜欢喝茶。
Wǒ bù xǐhuan hē kāfēi, dànshì xǐhuan hē chá.
I don't like coffee, but I like tea.
我没有哥哥。
Wǒ méiyǒu gēge.
I don't have an older brother.
我昨天没去学校，因为我生病了。
Wǒ zuótiān méi qù xuéxiào, yīnwèi wǒ shēngbìng le.
I didn't go to school yesterday because I was sick.
她是老师。
Tā shì lǎoshī.
She is a teacher.
她是我的老师，也是我的朋友。
Tā shì wǒ de lǎoshī, yě shì wǒ de péngyou.
She is my teacher and also my friend.
这是我的书。
Zhè shì wǒ de shū.
This is my book.
桌子上的那本书是我妹妹的。
Zhuōzi shàng de nà běn shū shì wǒ mèimei de.
That book on the table belongs to my younger sister.
这是什么？
Zhè shì shénme?
What is this?
你今天晚上想吃什么？
Nǐ jīntiān wǎnshang xiǎng chī shénme?
What do you want to eat tonight?
他是谁？
Tā shì shéi?
Who is he?
门前面站着的那个人是谁？
Mén qiánmiàn zhàn zhe de nàge rén shì shéi?
Who is that person standing in front of the door?
你在哪儿？
Nǐ zài nǎr?
Where are you?
请问，你知道最近的书店在哪儿吗？
Qǐngwèn, nǐ zhīdào zuìjìn de shūdiàn zài nǎr ma?
Excuse me, do you know where the nearest bookstore is?
你有几个杯子？
Nǐ yǒu jǐ ge bēizi?
How many cups do you have?
你家有几口人？
Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
How many people are in your family?
